shared_invariants: the configured journal root is canonicalized once; descendant traversal and mutation use descriptor-relative operations with no-follow on every component, or an equivalent capability-safe primitive that cannot be defeated by a symlink swap

every structured identifier used as one path component (facet slug, entity id, import id, day, stream, or segment key) must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$, and dot or dot-dot components are always rejected

SOURCE and --out are whole paths, not structured identifiers: canonicalize an existing SOURCE without following descendants; open an existing --out parent no-follow; never apply the component regex to the whole path
symlinks, sockets, devices, fifos, and other special files are rejected anywhere an operation reads, copies, replaces, renames, or removes a tree
mutation uses the native journal or facet exclusive lock; an existence check and its create-only publish occur under the same lock
temporary files are unique create-new no-follow siblings, files are mode 0600, private artifact directories are mode 0700, and both file and containing directory are synced before success
no command starts a Python interpreter or resolves a dotted module
usage errors write one diagnostic to stderr and exit 64 before journal resolution or mutation

commands.grammar: journal archive export [--out PATH] [--quiet] [--day YYYYMMDD | --from YYYYMMDD [--to YYYYMMDD] | --to YYYYMMDD]
capabilities: export the journal tree minus PORTABLE_DENY (restic-copied globs, *.key, and top-level config/, link/, tokens/, awareness/, apps/, backup/, solstone/, plus imports/archive-merge-work/)
an unsliced empty journal contains only _export.json; present included-root directories are emitted when they exist, with no placeholder four-root members

when any of --day, --from, or --to is present, membership is exactly matching chronicle/<YYYYMMDD>/ trees plus _export.json; entities, facets, imports, extra roots, and days outside the window are absent
a valid window with zero matching days writes a zip that contains _export.json only, exit 0, with day_count, entity_count, and facet_count all 0
sliced manifest day_count is the number of matching days; entity_count and facet_count are 0
--day cannot be combined with --from or --to; --from after --to is a usage error (exit 64); a non-Gregorian day token is unsafe input (exit 65)
manifest keys are solstone_version, exported_at, source_journal, day_count, entity_count, and facet_count
default output is JOURNAL.exports/YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ.zip beside the journal
publish from a unique mode-0600 create-new no-follow sibling and leave no temporary residue on failure
reject symlinks and special files rather than dereferencing them
reject an output path inside the journal's chronicle, entities, facets, or imports trees so the archive cannot traverse its own temporary or final file
--quiet suppresses the success path and skipped-entry advisory but never suppresses errors or the live-supervisor warning

capabilities: accept a source with chronicle day directories or legacy flat day directories
reject a source that is equal to, inside, or contains the target journal
merge segments, entities, facets, and imports while ignoring identity and config
never overwrite an existing segment or import
deduplicate entity aliases, emails, and observations; destination scalar fields win; a second principal is demoted
stage ambiguous entity identity collisions instead of guessing
the source journal is immutable: all accepted source data is copied, never renamed, moved, removed, or rewritten

overlapping facets preserve destination facet.json; entity relationship and observation data merge by their domain rules; detected-entity and activity JSONL records deduplicate by nonempty id with destination winning; activity output directories and news files use destination-wins by relative path; facet logs append source records in stable order

each new item is staged and create-only published; each update item is staged with an item transaction manifest, original backup, replacement, and recovery phase so interruption resolves to the original or replacement item before the next merge
write a mode-0600 append-only decision log in a mode-0700 per-run artifact directory beside the target
any failed item exits nonzero and reports committed, skipped, and failed items; a failed merge never starts the indexer
--dry-run creates no file or directory anywhere, including logs, artifacts, staging, ambiguity records, and locks, and never invokes the indexer
after a wholly successful write merge, request the native in-process full index rebuild; a rebuild failure exits nonzero and reports that merge items were already committed

--json writes exactly one UTF-8 JSON line to stdout on success and to stderr on failure, with keys ok, code, source, dry_run, committed, skipped, failed, decision_log, staging_dir, index_rebuild, and summary
find sorted content-bearing facet directories that lack facet.json
content-bearing means a regular non-symlink file below entities, todos, activities, news, or logs excluding .gitkeep and *.lock
report without writing by default
with --fix publish the default declaration and its facet_heal audit entry in the Rust-owned append-only logs/facet-heals.jsonl as one recoverable transaction under the facet mutation lock

the repair transaction uses a synced manifest with staged declaration, audit payload, transaction id, and phase; the next facet mutation rolls back a pre-commit crash or finishes an idempotent post-commit audit append before doing new work
after repairs print the exact follow-up: Run 'journal indexer --rescan-full' to refresh the index.

capabilities: validate SOURCE and DEST as safe facet slugs and reject identical or missing facets before writing
hold one exclusive facet mutation lock across planning, staging, publishes, source removal, convey cleanup, and one facet_merge audit entry

before publishing, durably write a mode-0600 transaction manifest containing transaction id, source, destination, original-tree backups, staged destination, staged convey config, audit payload, and phase

each phase transition is file-and-directory synced; a caught failure rolls back before returning; after process death the next facet mutation recovers the manifest before accepting owner arguments, choosing rollback before commit-mark and roll-forward after commit-mark
lock-aware readers observe original SOURCE plus original DEST or final DEST; unlocked readers during the bounded rename window are outside this command's atomicity guarantee
the audit record carries the transaction id and recovery checks it before append, giving exactly-once audit emission across replay
destination facet.json wins unchanged
entity relationships merge with destination fields winning; observations deduplicate by content and observed_at in destination-first stable order

detected-entity JSONL and activity config/day JSONL deduplicate by nonempty id with destination winning; activity output directories and news files use destination-wins by relative path; facet logs append source records in stable order
source-only regular facet files are copied into the staged destination; an unrecognized conflicting regular file aborts before commit
remove SOURCE from config/convey.json selected and order fields in the same transaction
include consent in the audit params only when --consent is supplied
after commit request the native in-process full index rebuild; a rebuild failure exits nonzero and reports that the facet transaction committed

preserve stdin bytes exactly and print News for YYYYMMDD saved to FACET.
